findings.title: 7 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 51 top-holder wallets resolve to 7 linked groups holding 33.9% of supply. The largest (22 wallets) holds 25.2%.

findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 36.8% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 26.1% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: Linked wallets are selling
findings.detail: Clustered wallets moved out 0.09% of supply in the last 7 days.

findings.title: Smart Money is exiting
findings.detail: 25 Smart Money holders reduced their position by 0.42% of supply over 30 days.

findings.title: Fresh wallets are driving demand
findings.detail: Brand-new wallets net bought $2,097,039 this week, far outpacing proven traders.
